instance_inputs.project_scope: Design and deploy an AI-powered workflow automation platform to streamline manufacturing and supply chain operations.

content.executive_summary: We are pleased to present this proposal to GlobalTech Industries for the AI Workflow Automation project. Our team brings deep expertise in AI-driven process automation, and we are confident this engagement will deliver measurable efficiency gains across your manufacturing and supply chain operations.
content.client_context: GlobalTech Industries operates across 12 manufacturing sites and currently manages supply chain coordination through a mix of legacy ERP systems and manual processes. This fragmentation creates delays, data inconsistencies, and significant operational overhead.
content.proposed_solution: We propose a phased AI Workflow Automation platform that integrates with your existing ERP systems, automates repetitive coordination tasks, and surfaces predictive insights for supply chain decision-making. The platform will be cloud-native, API-first, and fully auditable.
content.scope_of_work: Phase 1: Process audit and requirements gathering (4 weeks). Phase 2: Platform architecture and design (3 weeks). Phase 3: Core automation engine development (8 weeks). Phase 4: Integration testing and deployment (4 weeks). Phase 5: Training and handover (2 weeks).
content.timeline: The engagement is structured as a 21-week programme beginning on the agreed kickoff date. Key milestones: Requirements sign-off at Week 4, Architecture approval at Week 7, MVP demonstration at Week 15, Go-live at Week 19, and final handover at Week 21.
content.pricing: Based on the agreed scope, the total investment for this engagement is USD 48,000, inclusive of all phases and deliverables. Payment is structured in three instalments: 30% on contract signature, 40% at MVP demonstration, and 30% on final handover.
content.next_steps: To proceed, please review this proposal and sign the accompanying contract. Once signed, we will schedule a kickoff meeting within 5 business days. Please contact us at partnerships@acmeconsulting.com with any questions.
